text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and would love to help with your content editing needs.

With 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, I’m used to reviewing AI-generated output closely for accuracy, clarity, and consistency. In a private wiki question answering project for Strata Engineering Group, I built an on-premise assistant over 14k pages of engineering standards with zero external API calls, and it achieved an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions. I also built a monthly churn scoring system for a telecom client, producing per-customer SHAP reasons and reaching an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter.

I can bring the same detail-oriented approach to fact-checking, source review, and improving article quality and voice. I’m comfortable working independently, communicating clearly with technical teams, and meeting tight deadlines.

Preferred payment structure: hourly rate, though I’m open to discussing a fixed price depending on scope.
